origin: cwe/94/java Key Principles: Spring Expression Language against StandardEvaluationContext exposes type references and method invocation

finding.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code
finding.summary: A request-supplied rule expression is parsed as SpEL and evaluated against a StandardEvaluationContext, which permits powerful runtime access.

trap: Switching from ScriptEngine to SpEL, filtering only the string T(java.lang.Runtime), or using SimpleEvaluationContext as a claimed sandbox for arbitrary untrusted expressions. A correct fix removes untrusted expression evaluation or replaces it with a deny-by-default, narrowly allowed expression grammar.
must_preserve: Legitimate previews can still compute supported arithmetic over the supplied OrderContext, but expressions that invoke methods, reference types, construct objects, or reach beans/runtime APIs are rejected rather than evaluated.
